_readme: Third read for the Cerritos Ironworker ladder (S329). Read 2 (run 37233721702) answered the classroom hours (the 2026-27 IWAP course descriptions: 878 contact hours on the Reinforcing track, 898 on the Structural) and the B.S. start (Spring 2027, Cerritos's Field Ironwork page). It left two lines: the Technology division says Cerritos publishes its articulation agreements at Statewide Career Pathways, a link the reader did not follow off the college's domain; and Schedule+ chooses a department by form, so no link reached the term's AED or IWAP sections, while the AED catalog page's excerpts filled with high school courses before reaching AED 40-41. This read prints that link and the Schedule+ form, and reads the AED and WELD catalog pages with narrower keywords.

questions.noncredit_aed: Whether the 26 noncredit AED courses still run.
